app.name: Tazko
signin.title: Sign in to Tazko
signin.lead: Use the Google account your administrator invited. Workspace and personal accounts both work.
signin.note: Access is by invitation only. If you cannot sign in, ask your company owner to invite your email address.
signin.error.expired: The sign-in took too long or was started in another tab. Please try again.
signin.error.failed: Google sign-in did not complete. Please try again.
refused.title: This account is not invited
refused.lead: {email} is not on the list for Tazko.
refused.lead.unknown: This Google account is not on the list for Tazko.
refused.note.not_invited: Ask the owner of your company to invite this exact email address, then sign in again. If you meant to use a different Google account, choose it below.
refused.note.email_not_verified: Google has not verified this email address. Verify it with Google, or choose a different account below.
refused.note.disabled: This account has been turned off. Ask your administrator to turn it back on.
refused.note.account_mismatch: This email address belongs to a different Google account. Sign in with the account you used before, or ask your administrator for help.
admin.notAllowed: Only super admins can open the admin console.
companies.lead: Each company has its own database file and folder.
companies.empty: No companies yet. Create the first one.
newCompany.title: New company
newCompany.lead: Creates its folder and database. The first owner is invited by email.
newCompany.name: Company name
company.adminNote: Super admins manage people and invites here. Boards stay hidden unless you are a member of this company.
company.name: Company name
company.delete.title: Delete company
company.delete.lead: The folder and database move to trash and are kept for 30 days. After that they are removed for good.
deleteCompany.title: Delete {name}?
deleteCompany.lead: Its database and files move to trash for 30 days. Members lose access right away.
members.inviteHint: Email is not set up on this server, so share the site address with them yourself. When this person signs in with that Google account they join automatically. Workspace and personal Gmail addresses both work.
members.title: Members
members.none: No members yet. The first owner joins when they sign in.
invites.lead: Waiting for the person to sign in with Google.
projects.note: Super admins see project names, owners and counts only, never boards. Company owners manage projects and their owners.
audit.lead: Every admin action and every refused sign-in.
server.emailOff: Email is off. Invitations are shared by hand until email is set up in the server settings file.
switcher.label: Switch company
companyHome.lead: {company} · you see the projects you were invited to
companyHome.emptyBody: Only company owners create projects, and project owners add people to them. You see just the projects you belong to.
noAccess.title: Only company owners can open this page
companySettings.lead: {company} · you manage members and invites here as an owner
companySettings.storageHint: Files and the company database count towards the limit. A super admin can change it.
manage.lead: {company} · create, archive and delete projects, and choose their owners
manage.note: Boards stay private to each project. To look inside a project, add yourself to it. That is recorded in the audit log.
manage.empty: No projects yet. Create the first one.
manage.soon: Projects arrive with boards in the next milestone.
noCompany.title: You are not in any company yet
noCompany.body: Ask a company owner to invite your Google account, then sign in again.
missingCompany.title: This company is not available
missingCompany.body: It may have been suspended or removed, or you are no longer a member.
toast.superOff: {name} is no longer a super admin
server.backupsHint: The nightly backup runs at 02:30 and keeps 30 days. The restore test restores the newest backup every Sunday and checks it.
